```{r}
eligible_deliveries_data = eligible_deliveries_data %>% dplyr::mutate(
  
  bmi_cat0=cut(B_BMI, breaks=c(-Inf, 18.49999999, 25,30,35,40,100), labels=c("<18.5 kg/m2","18.5-24.9 kg/m2","25-29.9 kg/m2","30-34.9 kg/m2","35-39.9 kg/m2","40+ kg/m2")),
   bmi_cat0 = factor(bmi_cat0,levels = c("<18.5 kg/m2","18.5-24.9 kg/m2","25-29.9 kg/m2","30-34.9 kg/m2","35-39.9 kg/m2","40+ kg/m2")),
   
   bmi_cat = ifelse(is.na(bmi_cat0),"Missing BMI value",ifelse(bmi_cat0=="<18.5 kg/m2","Underweight (<18.5 kg/m2)",ifelse(bmi_cat0=="18.5-24.9 kg/m2","Normal weight (18.5-25 kg/m2)",ifelse(bmi_cat0=="25-29.9 kg/m2","Overweight (25-30 kg/m2)","Obese (>=30 kg/m2)")))),
  
   bmi_cat = factor(bmi_cat,levels = c("Normal weight (18.5-25 kg/m2)","Underweight (<18.5 kg/m2)", 
                                      "Overweight (25-30 kg/m2)", "Obese (>=30 kg/m2)", "Missing BMI value")),
  
  bmi_cat2 = cut(
  B_BMI,
  breaks = c(
    -Inf, 17.5, 20, 22.5, 25, 27.5,
    30, 32.5, 35, 37.5, 40, Inf
  ),
  labels = c(
    "<17.5", "17.5-20", "20-22.5", "22.5-25",
    "25-27.5", "27.5-30", "30-32.5", "32.5-35",
    "35-37.5", "37.5-40", "40>"
  ),
  right = FALSE
),

bmi_cat2 = as.character(bmi_cat2),

bmi_cat2 = ifelse(
  is.na(B_BMI),
  "Missing BMI value",
  bmi_cat2
),

bmi_cat2 = factor(
  bmi_cat2,
  levels = c(
    "<17.5", "17.5-20", "20-22.5", "22.5-25",
    "25-27.5", "27.5-30", "30-32.5", "32.5-35",
    "35-37.5", "37.5-40", "40>",
    "Missing BMI value"
  )
)
)
```

```{r}
  active_phenome_vars,
  names(eligible_deliveries_data)
)

if (length(missing_vars) > 0) {
  stop(
    "The following active-phenome variables are missing:\n",
    paste(missing_vars, collapse = "\n")
  )
}

## Independently calculate the number of conditions and MM status in R
eligible_deliveries_data <- eligible_deliveries_data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    number_of_conditions = rowSums(
      dplyr::across(
        dplyr::all_of(active_phenome_vars),
        ~ as.integer(.x == 1)
      ),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    MM_status = as.integer(number_of_conditions >= 2)
  )

## Distribution of the independently calculated R variable
table(
  eligible_deliveries_data$MM_status,
  useNA = "ifany"
)

prop.table(
  table(
    eligible_deliveries_data$MM_status,
    useNA = "ifany"
  )
)
```

### Select variables i need

```{r}
modeling_data = eligible_deliveries_data %>% dplyr::select(
  
  patid,PregStartDate,PregEndDate,
  
  ## Exposure status
  MM_status,
  ## Covariates
  age,preg_year,smoking,bmi_cat,bmi_cat2,ethnicity,IMD_quintiles,gravidity,
  ## Outcomes
  PretermBirth,
  PretermCode,
  VeryPreterm,
  ExtremelyPreterm,
  DelMeth,
  RecordedDelMeth,
  Stillbirth,
  SGA,
  SMMOverall,
  delonset,
  AnyInduction,
  InductionOPCS,
  PROMICD,
  LGA,
  gestat,
  
  # Anaesthesia before delivery
    epidural_pre_3cat,
    spinal_pre_3cat,
    general_pre_3cat,
    neuraxial_pre_3cat,

    # Anaesthesia after delivery
    spinal_post_3cat,
    general_post_3cat,
    any_anaes_post_3cat,

    # Place of birth
    delplac_3cat, 
    delinten_3cat,
  
  postdur
  
  
)

```

## Models

### 1. Preterm birth

#### Baseline characteristics

```{r}
## Vector of variables to summarize
myVars <- c("age","ethnicity","bmi_cat","smoking","gravidity","IMD_quintiles","PretermBirth")
## Vector of categorical variables that need transformation
catVars <- c("ethnicity","bmi_cat","smoking","gravidity","IMD_quintiles","PretermBirth")


baseline <- CreateTableOne(vars = myVars, data = modeling_data,strata = "MM_status", factorVars = catVars,addOverall = T)

table1_v1=data.frame(print(baseline, exact = "ascites", quote = F))

table1_v1 = tibble::rownames_to_column(table1_v1,"variable")

table1_v1$Vars = c("n","Mean (sd) age, years","Ethnicity","White","Black","Asian","Mixed","Others","Missing","BMI categories","Normal weight (18.5-25 kg/m2)","Underweight (<18.5 kg/m2)",  "Overweight (25-30 kg/m2)", "Obese (>=30 kg/m2)", "Missing BMI value","smoking status","non-smoker","smoker","ex-smoker","missing smoking status","Gravidity","G1","G2","G3","G4","G5","IMD","IMD 1","IMD 2","IMD 3","IMD 4","IMD 5","missing IMD","PretermBirth")

table1_v1$ID = c(1:nrow(table1_v1))

table1_v2=data.frame(print(baseline, exact = "ascites", quote = F,nonnormal=c("Age","bmi")))

table1_v2 = tibble::rownames_to_column(table1_v2,"variable")



table1_v2$Vars = c("n","Median (IQR) age, years","Ethnicity","White","Black","Asian","Mixed","Others","Missing","BMI categories","Normal weight (18.5-25 kg/m2)","Underweight (<18.5 kg/m2)",  "Overweight (25-30 kg/m2)", "Obese (>=30 kg/m2)", "Missing BMI value","smoking status","non-smoker","smoker","ex-smoker","missing smoking status","Gravidity","G1","G2","G3","G4","G5","IMD","IMD 1","IMD 2","IMD 3","IMD 4","IMD 5","missing IMD","PretermBirth")

table1_v2$ID = c(1:nrow(table1_v2))

table1_combined = rbind(table1_v1,table1_v2)
table1_combined2 <- table1_combined %>% distinct(Vars, .keep_all = TRUE)
table1_combined2 <- table1_combined2[order(table1_combined2$ID,decreasing=F),]
table1_combined2 = table1_combined2[,c(7,3,4,2)]

names(table1_combined2)=c("Variable","Without MM","With MM","Total")
write.csv(table1_combined2,"Table 1 PretermBirth.csv")

PretermBirth_table = read.csv("Table 1 PretermBirth.csv")[c(1,35),-1]



```

#### Modified poisson model

##### Univariable model - Active

```{r}
## Define your function, can change number of IVs in your model
func0 <- PretermBirth ~ MM_status

## Run your model
model <- geeglm(func0, 
             data=modeling_data,
             family = poisson(link="log"),id=patid,corstr = "exchangeable"
)

## Apply the sandwich error estimator
results <- summary(model)$coefficients

## Create table with Risk Ratios Ratios, Confidence Intervals, and P-Values
model_resultsUniv <- cbind(Variables=rownames(results),round(cbind(exp(cbind(RR = results[,1], 
                                       LCI = results[,1] + qnorm(0.05/2)*results[,2],
                                       UCI = results[,1] - qnorm(0.05/2)*results[,2])),
                                       P = results[,4]),3))

estimates=data.frame(model_resultsUniv)

write.csv(estimates,"ResultsMMActiveCCAUnivPretermBirth.csv")

ResultsMMActiveCCAUnivPretermBirth = estimates
ResultsMMActiveCCAUnivPretermBirth

```


##### Multivariable model - Active

```{r}

## Define your function, can change number of IVs in your model
func <- PretermBirth ~ MM_status + age + gravidity + ethnicity + IMD_quintiles + bmi_cat + smoking + preg_year

## Run your model

model <- geeglm(func, 
             data=modeling_data,
             family = poisson(link="log"),id=patid,corstr = "exchangeable"
)

## Apply the sandwich error estimator

results <- summary(model)$coefficients

## Create table with Risk Ratios Ratios, Confidence Intervals, and P-Values
model_results <- cbind(Variables=rownames(results),round(cbind(exp(cbind(RR = results[,1], 
                                       LCI = results[,1] + qnorm(0.05/2)*results[,2],
                                       UCI = results[,1] - qnorm(0.05/2)*results[,2])),
                                       P = results[,4]),3))

estimates=data.frame(model_results)

write.csv(estimates,"ResultsMMActiveCCAMultivPretermBirth.csv")

ResultsMMActiveCCAMultivPretermBirth=estimates

ResultsMMActiveCCAMultivPretermBirth

```

####Imputed data with GA as covariate
##### Univariable
```{r}

library(mice)
library(broom)   # optional, but nice to have

## 1. Define your model formula
func0 <- shoulder_dystocia ~ MM_status

## 2. Fit model in each imputed dataset
fit_mi <- with(imp.surv,
               geeglm(shoulder_dystocia ~ MM_status,
                   family = poisson(link = "log"),id=patid,corstr = "exchangeable")
)

## 3. Pool results across imputations (Rubin’s rules)
pooled <- pool(fit_mi)

## 4. Get summary with estimates, SEs, p-values
smry <- summary(pooled)   # columns: term, estimate, std.error, statistic, df, p.value

## 5. Build Risk Ratios, 95% CIs, and p-values (like your original code)

z <- qnorm(0.975)  # 97.5% for two-sided 95% CI

beta <- smry$estimate
se   <- smry$std.error

RR  <- exp(beta)
LCI <- exp(beta - z * se)
UCI <- exp(beta + z * se)
P   <- smry$p.value

model_resultsMI <- round(
  cbind(RR = RR,
        LCI = LCI,
        UCI = UCI,
        P  = P),
  3
)

estimates <- data.frame(term = smry$term, model_resultsMI)

## 6. Save to CSV and assign to an object (mirroring your original)
write.csv(estimates, "ResultsMMActiveMIUnivshoulder_dystociaImputed.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)

ResultsMMActiveMIUnivshoulder_dystociaImputed <- estimates
ResultsMMActiveMIUnivshoulder_dystociaImputed


```

```{r}
library(mice)

                   family = poisson(link = "log"),id=patid,corstr = "exchangeable")
)

pooled <- pool(fit_mi)

## 4. Get summary with estimates, SEs, p-values
smry <- summary(pooled)   # columns: term, estimate, std.error, statistic, df, p.value

## 5. Build Risk Ratios, 95% CIs, and p-values (like your original code)

z <- qnorm(0.975)  # 97.5% for two-sided 95% CI

beta <- smry$estimate
se   <- smry$std.error

RR  <- exp(beta)
LCI <- exp(beta - z * se)
UCI <- exp(beta + z * se)
P   <- smry$p.value

model_resultsMI <- round(
  cbind(RR = RR,
        LCI = LCI,
        UCI = UCI,
        P  = P),
  3
)

estimates <- data.frame(term = smry$term, model_resultsMI)

## 6. Save to CSV and assign to an object (mirroring your original)
```

#### Imputed data with GA as covariate

##### Univariable

```{r}

library(mice)
library(broom)   # optional, but nice to have

## 1. Define your model formula
func0 <- pereneal_tear ~ MM_status

## 2. Fit model in each imputed dataset
fit_mi <- with(imp.surv,
               geeglm(pereneal_tear ~ MM_status,
                   family = poisson(link="log"),id=patid,corstr = "exchangeable")
)

## 3. Pool results across imputations (Rubin’s rules)
pooled <- pool(fit_mi)

## 4. Get summary with estimates, SEs, p-values
smry <- summary(pooled)   # columns: term, estimate, std.error, statistic, df, p.value

## 5. Build Risk Ratios, 95% CIs, and p-values (like your original code)

z <- qnorm(0.975)  # 97.5% for two-sided 95% CI

beta <- smry$estimate
se   <- smry$std.error

RR  <- exp(beta)
LCI <- exp(beta - z * se)
UCI <- exp(beta + z * se)
P   <- smry$p.value

model_resultsMI <- round(
  cbind(RR = RR,
        LCI = LCI,
        UCI = UCI,
        P  = P),
  3
)

estimates <- data.frame(term = smry$term, model_resultsMI)

## 6. Save to CSV and assign to an object (mirroring your original)
write.csv(estimates, "ResultsMMActiveMIUnivpereneal_tearImputed.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)

ResultsMMActiveMIUnivpereneal_tearImputed <- estimates
ResultsMMActiveMIUnivpereneal_tearImputed


```

```{r}
)

        LCI = LCI,
        UCI = UCI,

)
```

### 15. Maternal death (upto 42 days after pregnancy end)

### Delivery cohort, existing exposure and covariates

```{r}
# Use the delivery cohort and the same adjusted-model covariates as outcomes 1-14.
# The existing MM_status exposure is retained unchanged.
mortality_vars <- c(
  "patid", "PregStartDate", "PregEndDate", "MM_status",
  "age", "gravidity", "ethnicity", "IMD_quintiles",
  "bmi_cat", "smoking", "preg_year"
)
stopifnot(all(mortality_vars %in% names(eligible_deliveries_data)))

# Raw BMI is used only for the existing descriptive baseline tables, if available.
stopifnot("B_BMI" %in% names(eligible_deliveries_data))

model_data <- eligible_deliveries_data %>%
  dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(mortality_vars), B_BMI) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(patid = as.character(patid))

mortality_keys <- c("patid", "PregStartDate", "PregEndDate")
stopifnot(!anyNA(model_data[mortality_keys]))
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(model_data[mortality_keys]))

mortality_data <- readRDS(
  "/rds/projects/s/subramaa-mum-predict/Signal Detection/Pregnancy Base Cohort/Individual Outcomes Analysis - WP3/Delivery Cohort/MaternalDeathOutcomes_DeliveryCohort.rds"
)



# Align the death-data patient identifier to the delivery cohort.
if ("patient_id" %in% names(mortality_data)) {
  mortality_data <- mortality_data %>%
    dplyr::mutate(patid = as.character(patient_id))
} else {
  stopifnot("patid" %in% names(mortality_data))
  mortality_data <- mortality_data %>%
    dplyr::mutate(patid = as.character(patid))
}

mortality_data <- mortality_data %>%
  dplyr::select(
    dplyr::all_of(mortality_keys),
    maternal_death, late_maternal_death
  )
stopifnot(!anyNA(mortality_data[mortality_keys]))
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(mortality_data[mortality_keys]))

n_deliveries <- nrow(model_data)
model_data <- model_data %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    mortality_data,
    by = mortality_keys,
    relationship = "one-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Age = age,
    bmi = B_BMI,
    imd = IMD_quintiles
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(patid)

stopifnot(nrow(model_data) == n_deliveries)
cat("Eligible deliveries:", nrow(model_data), "\n")
cat("Unmatched/NA early mortality:", sum(is.na(model_data$maternal_death)), "\n")
cat("Unmatched/NA late mortality:", sum(is.na(model_data$late_maternal_death)), "\n")
print(table(model_data$MM_status, model_data$maternal_death, useNA = "ifany"))
print(table(model_data$MM_status, model_data$late_maternal_death, useNA = "ifany"))
# Do not recode missing mortality outcomes as 0 before checking linkage/follow-up.
# Compatibility with the existing baseline-table grouping variable.
model_data$MMstatusActive <- model_data$MM_status

```

#### Modified poisson model

##### Univariable model - Active

```{r}
## Define your function, can change number of IVs in your model
func0 <- icu_within_3m ~ MM_status

## Run your model
model <- geeglm(func0, 
             data=modeling_data,
             family = poisson(link="log"),id=patid,corstr = "exchangeable"
)

## Apply the sandwich error estimator
results <- summary(model)$coefficients

## Create table with Risk Ratios Ratios, Confidence Intervals, and P-Values
model_resultsUniv <- cbind(Variables=rownames(results),round(cbind(exp(cbind(RR = results[,1], 
                                       LCI = results[,1] + qnorm(0.05/2)*results[,2],
                                       UCI = results[,1] - qnorm(0.05/2)*results[,2])),
                                       P = results[,4]),3))

estimates=data.frame(model_resultsUniv)

write.csv(estimates,"ResultsMMActiveCCAUnivicu_within_3m.csv")

ResultsMMActiveCCAUnivicu_within_3m = estimates
ResultsMMActiveCCAUnivicu_within_3m
```

### 23. Postdur less than 2 days

```{r}

modeling_data = modeling_data_original

modeling_data <- modeling_data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    postdur_cat = case_when(
      postdur <= 2              ~ "0",   # ≤2 days
      postdur >= 3 & postdur <= 6   ~ "1",   # 3–6 days
      postdur >= 7              ~ "2",   # ≥7 days
      TRUE                  ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

modeling_data$postdur_cat <- factor(modeling_data$postdur_cat,
                        levels = c("0",
                                   "1",
                                   "2"),
                        ordered = TRUE)

table(modeling_data$postdur_cat)


k = modeling_data %>% dplyr::group_by(postdur_cat) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
                   min = min(postdur),
                   max=max(postdur))
k


modeling_data = subset(modeling_data,!is.na(modeling_data$postdur_cat))

modeling_data = modeling_data %>% dplyr::mutate(
  
  postdur_less_2days = ifelse(postdur_cat=="0",1,0)
)

```

```{r}
## Vector of categorical variables that need transformation
```

```{r}
             data=modeling_data,
             family = poisson(link="log"),id=patid,corstr = "exchangeable"
)

                                       LCI = results[,1] + qnorm(0.05/2)*results[,2],
```

### 24. Postdur (3-6 days)

```{r}

modeling_data = modeling_data_original

modeling_data <- modeling_data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    postdur_cat = case_when(
      postdur <= 2              ~ "0",   # ≤2 days
      postdur >= 3 & postdur <= 6   ~ "1",   # 3–6 days
      postdur >= 7              ~ "2",   # ≥7 days
      TRUE                  ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

modeling_data$postdur_cat <- factor(modeling_data$postdur_cat,
                        levels = c("0",
                                   "1",
                                   "2"),
                        ordered = TRUE)

table(modeling_data$postdur_cat)


k = modeling_data %>% dplyr::group_by(postdur_cat) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
                   min = min(postdur),
                   max=max(postdur))
k


modeling_data = subset(modeling_data,!is.na(modeling_data$postdur_cat))

modeling_data = filter(modeling_data,postdur_cat %in% c("0","1"))

modeling_data = modeling_data %>% dplyr::mutate(
  
  postdur_btn_3and6days = ifelse(postdur_cat=="1",1,0)
)

```

#### Modified poisson model

##### Univariable model - Active

```{r}
## Define your function, can change number of IVs in your model
func0 <- neuraxial ~ MM_status

## Run your model
model <- geeglm(func0, 
             data=modeling_data,
             family = poisson(link="log"),id=patid,corstr = "exchangeable"
)

## Apply the sandwich error estimator
results <- summary(model)$coefficients

## Create table with Risk Ratios Ratios, Confidence Intervals, and P-Values
model_resultsUniv <- cbind(Variables=rownames(results),round(cbind(exp(cbind(RR = results[,1], 
                                       LCI = results[,1] + qnorm(0.05/2)*results[,2],
                                       UCI = results[,1] - qnorm(0.05/2)*results[,2])),
                                       P = results[,4]),3))

estimates=data.frame(model_resultsUniv)

write.csv(estimates,"ResultsMMActiveCCAUnivneuraxial.csv")

ResultsMMActiveCCAUnivneuraxial = estimates
ResultsMMActiveCCAUnivneuraxial
```

```{r}
myVars <- c("age","ethnicity","bmi_cat","smoking","gravidity","IMD_quintiles","IntendedPlaceofBirth")
## Vector of categorical variables that need transformation
catVars <- c("ethnicity","bmi_cat","smoking","gravidity","IMD_quintiles","IntendedPlaceofBirth")


baseline <- CreateTableOne(vars = myVars, data = modeling_data,strata = "MM_status", factorVars = catVars,addOverall = T)

table1_v1=data.frame(print(baseline, exact = "ascites", quote = F))

table1_v1 = tibble::rownames_to_column(table1_v1,"variable")

table1_v1$Vars = c("n","Mean (sd) age, years","Ethnicity","White","Black","Asian","Mixed","Others","Missing","BMI categories","Normal weight (18.5-25 kg/m2)","Underweight (<18.5 kg/m2)",  "Overweight (25-30 kg/m2)", "Obese (>=30 kg/m2)", "Missing BMI value","smoking status","non-smoker","smoker","ex-smoker","missing smoking status","Gravidity","G1","G2","G3","G4","G5","IMD","IMD 1","IMD 2","IMD 3","IMD 4","IMD 5","missing IMD","IntendedPlaceofBirth")

table1_v1$ID = c(1:nrow(table1_v1))

table1_v2=data.frame(print(baseline, exact = "ascites", quote = F,nonnormal=c("Age","bmi")))

table1_v2 = tibble::rownames_to_column(table1_v2,"variable")



table1_v2$Vars = c("n","Median (IQR) age, years","Ethnicity","White","Black","Asian","Mixed","Others","Missing","BMI categories","Normal weight (18.5-25 kg/m2)","Underweight (<18.5 kg/m2)",  "Overweight (25-30 kg/m2)", "Obese (>=30 kg/m2)", "Missing BMI value","smoking status","non-smoker","smoker","ex-smoker","missing smoking status","Gravidity","G1","G2","G3","G4","G5","IMD","IMD 1","IMD 2","IMD 3","IMD 4","IMD 5","missing IMD","IntendedPlaceofBirth")

table1_v2$ID = c(1:nrow(table1_v2))

table1_combined = rbind(table1_v1,table1_v2)
table1_combined2 <- table1_combined %>% distinct(Vars, .keep_all = TRUE)
table1_combined2 <- table1_combined2[order(table1_combined2$ID,decreasing=F),]
table1_combined2 = table1_combined2[,c(7,3,4,2)]

names(table1_combined2)=c("Variable","Without MM","With MM","Total")
write.csv(table1_combined2,"Table 1 IntendedPlaceofBirth.csv")


```

#### Modified poisson model

##### Univariable model - Active

```{r}
## Define your function, can change number of IVs in your model
func0 <- IntendedPlaceofBirth ~ MM_status

## Run your model
model <- geeglm(func0, 
             data=modeling_data,
             family = poisson(link="log"),id=patid,corstr = "exchangeable"
)

## Apply the sandwich error estimator
results <- summary(model)$coefficients

## Create table with Risk Ratios Ratios, Confidence Intervals, and P-Values
model_resultsUniv <- cbind(Variables=rownames(results),round(cbind(exp(cbind(RR = results[,1], 
                                       LCI = results[,1] + qnorm(0.05/2)*results[,2],
                                       UCI = results[,1] - qnorm(0.05/2)*results[,2])),
                                       P = results[,4]),3))

estimates=data.frame(model_resultsUniv)

write.csv(estimates,"ResultsMMActiveCCAUnivIntendedPlaceofBirth.csv")

ResultsMMActiveCCAUnivIntendedPlaceofBirth = estimates
ResultsMMActiveCCAUnivIntendedPlaceofBirth

```


##### Multivariable model - Active

```{r}

## Define your function, can change number of IVs in your model
func <- IntendedPlaceofBirth ~ MM_status + age + gravidity + ethnicity + IMD_quintiles + bmi_cat + smoking + preg_year

## Run your model

model <- geeglm(func, 
             data=modeling_data,
             family = poisson(link="log"),id=patid,corstr = "exchangeable"
)

## Apply the sandwich error estimator

results <- summary(model)$coefficients

## Create table with Risk Ratios Ratios, Confidence Intervals, and P-Values
model_results <- cbind(Variables=rownames(results),round(cbind(exp(cbind(RR = results[,1], 
                                       LCI = results[,1] + qnorm(0.05/2)*results[,2],
                                       UCI = results[,1] - qnorm(0.05/2)*results[,2])),
                                       P = results[,4]),3))

estimates=data.frame(model_results)

write.csv(estimates,"ResultsMMActiveCCAMultivIntendedPlaceofBirth.csv")

ResultsMMActiveCCAMultivIntendedPlaceofBirth=estimates

ResultsMMActiveCCAMultivIntendedPlaceofBirth

```

```{r}
## --- Insert “section header” rows for each outcome (updated for new outcomes in active1.csv) ---



active1 = antenatal_estimates


library(dplyr)
# If insertRows() is from DataCombine:

# (Optional) ensure consistent ordering (as currently in file)
# active1 <- active1 %>% arrange(Outcome, Model)

# Outcome order as they appear in the dataset
outcome_order <- active1 %>%
  dplyr::pull(Outcome) %>%
  unique()

# Pretty labels (name each outcome)
pretty_outcome <- c(
  "PretermBirth"                                  = "Preterm birth",
  "Stillbirth"                                    = "Stillbirth",
  "SGA"                                           = "SGA",
  "SMMOverall"                                    = "SMM",
  "InductionOPCS"                                 = "Induction of labour",
  "AnyInduction"                                  = "Any induction",
  "spontaneous"                                   = "Spontaneous birth",
  "PROM"                                          = "PROM",
  "Postpartum_Hemorrage"                          = "Postpartum haemorrhage",
  "shoulder_dystocia"                             = "Shoulder dystocia",
  "LGA"                                           = "LGA",
  "pereneal_tear"                                 = "Perineal trauma (3rd or 4th degree tear)",
  "hysterectomy"                                  = "Hysterectomy",
  "maternal_death"                                = "Maternal death",
  "late_maternal_death"                           = "Late maternal death",
  "maternal_infection"                            = "Maternal infection",
  "icu_within_3m"                                 = "ICU admission",
  "hospital_admission_within_3m"                  = "Hospital admission",
  "los_less_2days"                                = "Length of stay (< 2 days)",
  "los_3to6days"                             = "Length of stay (2 to 7 days)",
  "los_7ormoredays"                                 = "Length of stay (> 7 days)",
  "postdur_less_2days"                            = "Postnatal duration (< 2 days)",
  "postdur_btn_3and6days"                         = "Postnatal duration (2 to 7 days)",
  "postdur_7andmore"                             = "Postnatal duration (> 7 days)",
  "Postpartum_anxiety"                            = "Postpartum anxiety",
  "Postpartum_depression"                         = "Postpartum depression",
  "infant_death"                                  = "Infant death",
  "neonatal_death"                                = "Neonatal death",

  # New anaesthesia & place of birth outcomes
  "Epidural (pre-delivery)"                       = "Epidural (before delivery)",
  "Spinal (pre-delivery)"                         = "Spinal anaesthesia (before delivery)",
  "General anaesthesia (pre-delivery)"            = "General anaesthesia (before delivery)",
  "Any neuraxial (pre-delivery)"                  = "Any neuraxial anaesthesia (before delivery)",
  "Spinal (post-delivery)"                        = "Spinal anaesthesia (after delivery)",
  "General anaesthesia (post-delivery)"           = "General anaesthesia (after delivery)",
  "Any anaesthesia (post-delivery)"               = "Any anaesthesia (after delivery)",
  "Actual place of birth (Home vs Hospital)"      = "Actual place of birth (home vs hospital)",
  "Intended place of birth (Home vs Hospital)"    = "Intended place of birth (home vs hospital)",

  # CS outcomes
  "elective_CS"                                   = "Elective CS",
  "emergency_CS"                                  = "Emergency CS",
  "Caeserean section"                             = "Caesarean section"
)

# Header insertion rows: 1,4,7,... for as many outcomes as exist
insert_at <- seq(1, by = 3, length.out = length(outcome_order))

# Insert blank rows
active1 <- insertRows(active1, insert_at, new = NA)

# Put the pretty label into the Outcome column in the inserted rows
outcome_col <- which(names(active1) == "Outcome")

active1[insert_at, outcome_col] <- unname(pretty_outcome[outcome_order])

# Indent the Model text for non-header rows (same behaviour as your original)
active1$Model <- ifelse(
  is.na(active1$Variable),
  active1$Model,
  paste0("   ", active1$Model)
)
```

```{r}
active1$se <- ((log(active1$UCI) - log(active1$RR))/1.96)+0.5

active1$"RR (95% CI)" <- ifelse(is.na(active1$RR), "",
                             sprintf("%.2f (%.2f to %.2f)",
                                     active1$RR, active1$LCI, active1$UCI))

active1$`RR (95% CI)` = ifelse(is.na(active1$`RR (95% CI)`),"",active1$`RR (95% CI)`)


active1$Model = ifelse(is.na(active1$Model),active1$Outcome,active1$Model)
```

```{r}

make_event_table <- function(file, label, rows = c(1, 35)) {
  tab <- read.csv(file)[rows, -1]
  names(tab) <- c("Variable", "Unexposed", "Exposed", "n")
  tab$events_in_unexposed <- NA
  tab$events_in_exposed   <- NA
  tab[1, "events_in_unexposed"] <- tab[2, "Unexposed"]
  tab[1, "events_in_exposed"]   <- tab[2, "Exposed"]
  tab <- tab[, c("Variable", "events_in_unexposed", "Unexposed",
                 "events_in_exposed", "Exposed", "n")]
  tab <- tab[-2, ]
  tab$Variable <- label
  tab
}

## Core outcomes
PretermBirth_table        <- make_event_table("Table 1 PretermBirth.csv",        "PretermBirth")
Stillbirth_table          <- make_event_table("Table 1 Stillbirth.csv",          "Stillbirth")
SGA_table                 <- make_event_table("Table 1 SGA.csv",                 "SGA")
PROMICD_table             <- make_event_table("Table 1 PROMICD.csv",             "PROM")
AnyInduction_table        <- make_event_table("Table 1 AnyInduction.csv",        "AnyInduction")
InductionOPCS_table       <- make_event_table("Table 1 InductionOPCS.csv",       "InductionOPCS")
LGA_table                 <- make_event_table("Table 1 LGA.csv",                 "LGA")
pereneal_tear_table       <- make_event_table("Table 1 pereneal_tear.csv",       "pereneal_tear")
hysterectomy_table        <- make_event_table("Table 1 hysterectomy.csv",        "hysterectomy")
Postpartum_Hemorrage_table<- make_event_table("Table 1 Postpartum_Hemorrage.csv","Postpartum_Hemorrage")
maternal_death_table      <- make_event_table("Table 1 maternal_death.csv",      "maternal_death",      rows = c(1, 35))
late_maternal_death_table <- make_event_table("Table 1 late_maternal_death.csv", "late_maternal_death", rows = c(1, 35))
SMMOverall_table          <- make_event_table("Table 1 SMMOverall.csv",          "SMMOverall")
shoulder_dystocia_table   <- make_event_table("Table 1 shoulder_dystocia.csv",   "shoulder_dystocia")
```

```{r}
  "postdur_less_2days"                            = "Postnatal duration (< 2 days)",

  "postdur_7andmore"                             = "Postnatal duration (> 7 days)",

  "Spinal (pre-delivery)"                         = "Spinal anaesthesia (before delivery)",
  "General anaesthesia (pre-delivery)"            = "General anaesthesia (before delivery)",

  # CS outcomes
  "elective_CS"                                   = "Elective CS",
  "emergency_CS"                                  = "Emergency CS",
  "Caeserean section"                             = "Caesarean section"
)

# Header insertion rows: 1,4,7,... for as many outcomes as exist
insert_at <- seq(1, by = 3, length.out = length(outcome_order))

# Insert blank rows
active1 <- insertRows(active1, insert_at, new = NA)

# Put the pretty label into the Outcome column in the inserted rows
outcome_col <- which(names(active1) == "Outcome")

active1[insert_at, outcome_col] <- unname(pretty_outcome[outcome_order])

# Indent the Model text for non-header rows (same behaviour as your original)
active1$Model <- ifelse(
  is.na(active1$Variable),
  active1$Model,
  paste0("   ", active1$Model)
)
```

```{r}
active1$se <- ((log(active1$UCI) - log(active1$RR))/1.96)+0.5

active1$"" <- paste(rep(" ", 20), collapse = " ")


active1$"RR (95% CI)" <- ifelse(is.na(active1$RR), "",
                             sprintf("%.2f (%.2f to %.2f)",
                                     active1$RR, active1$LCI, active1$UCI))

active1$`RR (95% CI)` = ifelse(is.na(active1$`RR (95% CI)`),"",active1$`RR (95% CI)`)


active1$Model = ifelse(is.na(active1$Model),active1$Outcome,active1$Model)
```

```{r}

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)

# --- 1) Read file ---
dat <- read_csv("main_analysis_metanalysis_dataFinal.csv")

# --- 2) Journal-ready labels (covers ALL outcomes in your file) ---
outcome_map <- tribble(
  ~Outcome, ~Outcome_journal,
  "PretermBirth", "Preterm birth",
  "Stillbirth", "Stillbirth",
  "SGA", "Small for gestational age",
  "LGA", "Large for gestational age",
  "PROM", "Prelabour rupture of membranes (PROM)",
  "AnyInduction", "Induction of labour (any)",
  "InductionOPCS", "Induction of labour (OPCS-coded)",
  "pereneal_tear", "Perineal tear",
  "hysterectomy", "Hysterectomy",
  "Postpartum_Hemorrage", "Postpartum haemorrhage",
  "maternal_death", "Maternal death",
  "late_maternal_death", "Late maternal death",
  "SMMOverall", "Severe maternal morbidity (overall)",
  "shoulder_dystocia", "Shoulder dystocia",
  "Caeserean section", "Caesarean section",
  "emergency_CS", "Emergency caesarean section",
  "elective_CS", "Elective caesarean section",
  "spontaneous", "Spontaneous vaginal birth",
  "maternal_infection", "Maternal infection",
  "icu_within_3m", "ICU admission within 3 months postpartum",
  "hospital_admission_within_3m", "Hospital admission within 3 months postpartum",
  "los_less_2days", "Length of stay ≤2 days",
  "los_3to6days", "Length of stay 3–6 days",
  "los_7ormoredays", "Length of stay ≥7 days",
  "postdur_less_2days", "Postnatal stay ≤2 days",
  "postdur_btn_3and6days", "Postnatal stay 3–6 days",
  "postdur_7andmore", "Postnatal stay ≥7 days",
  "Postpartum_depression", "Postpartum depression",
  "Postpartum_anxiety", "Postpartum anxiety",
  "infant_death", "Infant death",
  "neonatal_death", "Neonatal death",
  "Epidural (pre-delivery)", "Epidural anaesthesia (pre-delivery)",
  "Spinal (pre-delivery)", "Spinal anaesthesia (pre-delivery)",
  "General anaesthesia (pre-delivery)", "General anaesthesia (pre-delivery)",
  "Any neuraxial (pre-delivery)", "Any neuraxial anaesthesia (pre-delivery)",
  "Spinal (post-delivery)", "Spinal anaesthesia (post-delivery)",
  "General anaesthesia (post-delivery)", "General anaesthesia (post-delivery)",
  "Any anaesthesia (post-delivery)", "Any anaesthesia (post-delivery)",
  "Actual place of birth (Home vs Hospital)", "Actual place of birth (home vs hospital)",
  "Intended place of birth (Home vs Hospital)", "Intended place of birth (home vs hospital)"
)

dat2 <- dat %>%
  left_join(outcome_map, by = "Outcome")

# Safety check: ensure every Outcome was mapped
unmapped <- dat2 %>% filter(is.na(Outcome_journal)) %>% distinct(Outcome)
if (nrow(unmapped) > 0) {
  message("Unmapped outcomes found (please add to outcome_map):")
  print(unmapped)
}

# --- 3) Manuscript-ready ordering (Maternal → Delivery → Offspring) ---
# NOTE: I treat LOS/postnatal stay + postpartum mental health + admissions as "Maternal (postpartum)".
# If you want LOS/postnatal stay under "Delivery" instead, tell me and I’ll adjust.
outcome_order <- c(
  # Maternal (pregnancy/postpartum)
  "Severe maternal morbidity (overall)",
  "Postpartum haemorrhage",
  "Hysterectomy",
  "Maternal infection",
  "ICU admission within 3 months postpartum",
  "Hospital admission within 3 months postpartum",
  "Length of stay ≤2 days",
  "Length of stay 3–6 days",
  "Length of stay ≥7 days",
  "Postnatal stay ≤2 days",
  "Postnatal stay 3–6 days",
  "Postnatal stay ≥7 days",
  "Postpartum depression",
  "Postpartum anxiety",
  "Maternal death",
  "Late maternal death",

  # Delivery / intrapartum / perinatal care
  "Intended place of birth (home vs hospital)",
  "Actual place of birth (home vs hospital)",
  "Prelabour rupture of membranes (PROM)",
  "Induction of labour (any)",
  "Induction of labour (OPCS-coded)",
  "Epidural anaesthesia (pre-delivery)",
  "Spinal anaesthesia (pre-delivery)",
  "General anaesthesia (pre-delivery)",
  "Any neuraxial anaesthesia (pre-delivery)",
  "Spinal anaesthesia (post-delivery)",
  "General anaesthesia (post-delivery)",
  "Any anaesthesia (post-delivery)",
  "Caesarean section",
  "Emergency caesarean section",
  "Elective caesarean section",
  "Spontaneous vaginal birth",
  "Perineal tear",
  "Shoulder dystocia",
  "Preterm birth",
  "Small for gestational age",
  "Large for gestational age",

  # Offspring
  "Stillbirth",
  "Neonatal death",
  "Infant death"
)

maternal_set  <- outcome_order[1:16]
delivery_set  <- outcome_order[17:38]
offspring_set <- outcome_order[39:41]

dat2 <- dat2 %>%
  mutate(
    Outcome_domain = case_when(
      Outcome_journal %in% maternal_set  ~ "Maternal",
      Outcome_journal %in% delivery_set  ~ "Delivery",
      Outcome_journal %in% offspring_set ~ "Offspring",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    Outcome_domain = factor(Outcome_domain, levels = c("Maternal", "Delivery", "Offspring", "Other")),
    Outcome_journal_ord = factor(Outcome_journal, levels = outcome_order, ordered = TRUE)
  )

# Optional check: anything not in the ordered list?
not_in_order <- dat2 %>%
  filter(!is.na(Outcome_journal) & is.na(Outcome_journal_ord)) %>%
  distinct(Outcome_journal)

if (nrow(not_in_order) > 0) {
  message("Outcomes with journal labels not present in outcome_order (please add):")
  print(not_in_order)
}


dat2 = dat2[,c(10,2:9)]

# --- 4) Save output ---
write_csv(dat2, "main_analysis_metanalysis_dataFinal_AdjustedClean.csv")


```

## BMI estimates

```{r}

all_variable_estimates0=all_variable_estimates


all_variable_estimates = all_variable_estimates0

all_variable_estimates = all_variable_estimates %>% dplyr::rename(Variable = Variables)



all_variable_estimates=all_variable_estimates %>% 
    filter(str_detect(Variable, pattern = "bmi"))


all_variable_estimates <- all_variable_estimates %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Variable = Variable %>%
      
      # 1) Remove anything after the final closing bracket, but KEEP the bracket
      str_remove("(?<=\\)).*$") %>%
      
      # 3) General case: remove any single digit at end of string
      str_remove("\\d+$") %>%
      
      # 4) Trim any extra spaces created
      str_trim()
  )



all_variable_estimates$"RR (95% CI)" <- ifelse(is.na(as.numeric(all_variable_estimates$RR)), "",
                             sprintf("%.3f (%.3f to %.3f)",
                                     as.numeric(all_variable_estimates$RR), as.numeric(all_variable_estimates$LCI), as.numeric(all_variable_estimates$UCI)))


all_variable_estimates = all_variable_estimates[,c(1,8,6)]

names(all_variable_estimates) = c("Variable","Estimate","Outcome")

#all_variable_estimates = all_variable_estimates %>% tidyr::spread(Outcome,Estimate)


#all_variable_estimates = all_variable_estimates[,c(1,8,11,6,5,13,3,2,4,7,9,10,12)]


# all_variable_estimates = all_variable_estimates[,c("Variable","Miscarriage","TOP","GH","GDM","VTE","Cholestasis","AbruptionPlacentae","Chorioamnionitis","Hyperemisis","PlacentaInsufficiency","Preeclampsia","Vomiting","AntenatalDepression","AntenatalAnxiety")]

write.csv(all_variable_estimates,"BMI estimates.csv")
```
